subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When more than one assurance pass is required, the orchestrator shall keep passes mutually blind until every pass has a revision-bound terminal, union all surviving findings, and derive one aggregate using the most restrictive pass verdict; any missing, stale, invalid, non-accepting, or disagreeing pass shall keep the aggregate non-accepting until the exact revision completes a satisfying full pass set.
rationale: independent evidence must be preserved and pessimistically combined, never cherry-picked
fit_criterion: pass-order and candidate-order fixtures produce the same union and aggregate; missing-pass, split-verdict, conflicting-finding, and favorable-subset fixtures remain non-accepting and preserve all results
